correctness.rationale: Variation of constants and the complete cosine orthogonal Wiener basis give c_j=sqrt(2h)q[(-1)^j-e^-q]/(q²+pi²j²) and exact strong endpoint error sigma²h sum_{j not in S} w_j. Orthogonal contributions imply sorting K weights, each parity strictly decreases, the leading weight j=1 dominates all, so 2nd weight is max(j=2,j=3). Their equality is e^-q(2q²+13pi²)=5pi²; derivative negative for all q>0 proves one root. Dominated convergence gives all-K small/large q and 84.1099% small-q gain. Independent scipy root 0.970073759602 and rankings for q=.1,.9,1,3,20 agree. This is exact integration of smooth forcing, not numerical SDC error.
